The President and Chief Executive Officer of Coscharis Group, Cosmas Maduka, has paid an emotional tribute to his late wife, Charity Maduka, five years after her death, recalling their marriage, the memories they shared and the pain of losing her. Maduka, in an emotional Instagram post on Friday, described November 27, 2021, when his wife died, as the darkest day of his life, admitting that he almost gave up following the devastating loss. He, however, credited God for giving him the strength to overcome the difficult period and continue with life. Reflecting on the experience, the businessman wrote, “He sustained me when I had no strength left, held me together when I was broken, and gave me grace to continue.” Recalling their years together, Maduka acknowledged that their marriage was not perfect but said he treasured the love, laughter, companionship, dreams and challenges they shared. I would still marry you and call you my wife all over again.” The businessman also expressed his faith in the Christian promise of resurrection, saying he looked forward to reuniting with his wife in heaven. He referenced William Marrion Branham’s message, Expressions (62-0313), while reflecting on his Christian faith and the hope of seeing his wife again. Words fail me, Yul Edochie mourns father Chelsea loanee Garnacho deletes Aston Villa references from Instagram Moses Bliss excites fans with romantic video amid divorce rumours Maduka further disclosed that the anniversary had brought another painful experience for the family, as they were also burying his late wife’s immediate elder brother. He said he wished Charity were alive to participate in the burial arrangements, describing the occasion as a double sorrowful day for the family. Despite the grief, he maintained that their hope remained in Jesus Christ and the promise of eternal reunion. He concluded his tribute by describing Charity as a wife who would forever remain in his heart, adding that she was deeply missed and would never be forgotten. The tribute has offered a glimpse into the personal loss behind the businessman’s public life, as he continues to remember the woman with whom he shared many years of marriage.
